justification: Fannin and Pittman already played and locked in from the early slate, nothing to discuss there, that's done business. Everybody else rides the way they've been riding. Kyler Murray stays under center over Bo Nix — Nix projects a hair higher on some sheet, I don't care, Murray's the guy who actually showed up and threw for a touchdown the last time we lost, Nix was in the corner that week, and I don't churn a quarterback over seven-tenths of a point, that's panic and panic's how you lose a family. LaPorta stays at tight end over the fella sitting on my bench in New Orleans for the same reason — he produced in our last loss, the other guy's never worn the jersey in a game that mattered to me, loyalty's not a coin flip. Breece Hall and Achane are hurt and not touching this lineup, I got eyes, I don't need the paper to tell me that. Javonte and Chase Brown keep carrying the load, the kicker and the defense ride as-is, nobody's earned a bench this week and nobody's losing their spot over a bad month. And to whoever's whispering about my family upstairs — we're processing a rough start, that's all it is, processing. Don't mistake patience for weakness. Nobody threatens my people and sleeps easy.
